name: api-rest-nodejs
description: API REST completa con Node.js, Express, PostgreSQL, JWT y Docker

scripts.lint: node -c server.js && for f in src/**/*.js; do node -c "$f"; done
scripts.verify-docs: node -e "const spec = require('./src/config/swagger'); if (!spec.paths || Object.keys(spec.paths).length === 0) { console.error('No se generaron rutas en el spec de Swagger'); process.exit(1); } console.log(Object.keys(spec.paths).length + ' rutas documentadas en Swagger');"
